Entry Outsiders in Dorne How Donne viewed outsiders often says more about its character than official etiquette. Outsiders often misunderstand Dorne's independence and enthusiasm as arrogance, but Dornish people remember the price that foreign rule has brought; trade routes, marriage alliances, and wars will continue to force this judgment to change. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
